reason: One equivalent case remains on this line after the others were killed by section 9. With && the guard only fires when EVERY part is null, so a missing START can reach the arithmetic — but there it is coerced to 0, and the second half of the comparison then asks whether a real timestamp (about 1.8e12) is less than a few million milliseconds, which is false. The expression therefore still returns false for a booking with no start time, which is the same answer the guard gives. The two cases that were NOT equivalent — a missing DURATION on either side, where the arithmetic invents a zero-length booking and reports a collision — are pinned directly in section 9.
